```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Load is ~1 pF, so a 5T OTA cannot reach 230 MHz within 170 uW. Switching to a current-reuse push-pull output stage: the PMOS is DC-servoed by a small OTA, and both devices are AC-coupled to the inverting node. gm roughly doubles at the same current. Feedback resistors are lower to push the fb pole up."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W6":    (40.0, 16.0, 90.0),     # NMOS output device width [um] (mirror of MB0)
    "Ln6":   (0.18, 0.15, 0.35),     # L of MB0 / MT / MN6 (mirror group)
    "W7":    (100.0, 40.0, 220.0),   # PMOS output device width [um] (loop-controlled)
    "Lp7":   (0.18, 0.15, 0.35),     # L of MP7
    "Nout":  (5.8, 4.5, 6.2),        # output branch current / iref
    "Cc":    (3e-12, 1e-12, 6e-12),  # AC coupling caps fb->x and fb->gn
    "R1":    (8e3, 4e3, 20e3),       # series resistor from vin1
    "kgain": (0.1135, 0.108, 0.119), # Rf/R1 (LF loop gain is very high)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    W6, L6, W7, L7 = p["W6"], p["Ln6"], p["W7"], p["Lp7"]
    wb = W6 / p["Nout"]            # MB0 width -> I6 = Nout*iref
    wt = 0.5 * wb                  # OTA tail = iref/2
    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["kgain"] * R1
    Cc = p["Cc"]

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wb, L6)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wt, L6)
    # small DC-servo OTA: M1 gate fb (diode side), output x on M2/M4 side
    n.M("M1", "dg", "fb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", 3.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M2", "x", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", 3.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M3", "dg", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0, 0.5)
    n.M("M4", "x", "dg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0, 0.5)
    # current-reuse output stage
    n.M("MP7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W7, L7)
    n.M("MN6", "vout", "gn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, L6)
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "gn", 2e6)          # DC bias of MN6 = mirror of MB0
    n.C("CN", "fb", "gn", Cc)              # AC drive of MN6
    n.C("CC", "fb", "x", Cc)               # AC feed-forward to MP7 gate
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "fb", R1)
    n.R("RF", "fb", "vout", Rf)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    # ---- analytic model ----
    def solve(dv, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.6
        o = None
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            o = lut.op(dv, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)
            if o["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return o, mid
    i6 = p["Nout"] * iref
    itail = 0.5 * iref
    o6, vg6 = solve("n", W6, L6, i6, 0.9)
    o7, vsg7 = solve("p", W7, L7, i6, 0.9)
    o1, _ = solve("n", 3.0, 0.5, itail / 2, 0.5, 0.3)
    o4, _ = solve("p", 2.0, 0.5, itail / 2, 0.9)
    cl = 1.0e-12                            # load inferred from sim (~1 pF)
    gl = 1.0 / 16e3                         # inferred resistive load
    cg6 = o6["cgg"]; cg7 = o7["cgg"]
    k6 = Cc / (Cc + cg6 * 1.3); k7 = Cc / (Cc + cg7 * 1.3)
    gm_hf = o6["gm"] * k6 + o7["gm"] * k7
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    gout = gl + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf) + o6["gds"] + o7["gds"]
    cout = cl + 0.5e-15 * (W6 + W7) + 10e-15
    Thf = gm_hf * beta / gout
    a_ota = o1["gm"] / (o1["gds"] + o4["gds"])
    Tlf = a_ota * o7["gm"] / gout * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * Tlf / (1 + Tlf)
    flat = Thf / (1 + Thf)
    wcl = (gout + gm_hf * beta) / cout
    # -3 dB where flat/sqrt(1+(w/wcl)^2) = 0.707 of LF gain
    r = (flat / 0.7071) ** 2 - 1.0
    bw = wcl * math.sqrt(max(r, 0.05)) / (2 * PI)
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i6)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "bw": bw, "power": power, "vout_offset": 0.0}
```
